claim: The lexicographically first labelled four-star H516 surgery has no graph homomorphism into the exact 632-point strict unit-distance host H632.

selector.anchor: A source triangle maximizing the sum of its three final-graph degrees, with lexicographic tie-break.
selector.surgery: The first compatible four-centre tuple, then the first lexicographic allowed neighbour pair at each centre. Centres, tuples, and pairs are ordered increasingly by original H632 labels.
selector.target_images: Every permutation of every increasing target triangle in the complete exact H632 strict unit graph.

stopping_rule: Stop and retire this frozen source-host pair after complete anchored arc-consistency closure, any surviving anchored family without a separately declared finite decision, or an exact homomorphism.
